name_reason: Follows the fd2_animate_spell_* sibling convention in anicombt.c (fd2_animate_spell_impact_per_target / _full_screen_flash / _overlay_blink). The animate_spell token places it in the battle/spell-anim domain; descriptor 'projectile_paths' accurately captures the floating-damage / AoE sprite rise along fixed flight paths. No Ghidra address suffix.
purpose: Run the battle floating-damage / spell-projectile FX queue as a 22-frame animation, blitting each queued sprite (damage digits or AoE projectiles) rising over its target tile along a fixed 4-phase x 6-row y-offset pattern.
logic_summary: Copies the first 25 bytes of the 28-byte projectile y-offset table to a local. Gates on data_fd2_battle_spell_aoe_count_and_fx_queue_idx != 0 (else returns). Allocates a 0x25680 snapshot buffer and snapshots the live back-buffer (large_game_state_buffer). Loops frame=0..0x15 (22 frames): restore the clean back-buffer from the snapshot, then for each FX slot fx_iter in 0..count: skip if sprite_id (floating_damage_sprite_id_queue[fx_iter]) == 0; resolve sprite_addr = sprite_sheet + sprite_sheet[6 + sprite_id*4]; target = runtime_char_array[target_char_idx_queue[fx_iter]]; compute dst_addr = lgs + 0x8088 + (target.pos_y - origin_y)*0x2AC0 + (target.pos_x - origin_x)*0x18 + x_offset_queue[fx_iter] + (y_offset_table[fx_iter%4 + frame] - 3)*0x1C8; fd2_blit_sprite_with_decoded_pixels(dst_addr, sprite_addr, 0x1C8). After the inner loop, fd2_blit_rectangle(0xA0504,0x140,lgs+0x8088,0x1C8,0x138,0xC0) flushes to the mode13h primary, then fd2_delay_ms(2). After all frames: free the snapshot, fd2_delay_ms(500), then the Watcom cleanup tail (decompile shows it as fd2_noop_stub_1452 / tail-jump to shared epilogue 0x11452; reproduced in src as the function return).

returns.semantics: No return value. Side effect: animates the floating-damage/projectile FX queue onto the back-buffer and flushes to the mode13h primary surface.

writes_globals: data_fd2_large_game_state_buffer_ptr (0x53A49) target buffer contents (back-buffer pixels; restored each frame then blitted into)
comment_original_issue: Source comment described the per-frame fd2_delay_ms(2) call as 'delay 2 BIOS ticks' and the end delay as 'a ~500ms settle delay'. fd2_delay_ms (0x375B2) is a millisecond delay wrapping Watcom CRT __delay, not a BIOS-tick wait (the BIOS-tick pacer is the separate fd2_wait_n_bios_ticks). The '2 BIOS ticks' wording was inaccurate.
notes: void function, no params. Name kept (matches fd2_animate_spell_* convention, no address suffix). Only the per-frame/end delay wording in the src comment was corrected (fd2_delay_ms is ms-delay, not BIOS ticks); body logic untouched. Ghidra plate already accurate and consistent with live symbols (uses correct fd2_delay_ms(2)/fd2_delay_ms(500) wording; older Hungarian field names bPos_x/bPos_y match live Ghidra runtime_char) -> plate not modified. Caller fd2_execute_offensive_single_target_spell_id_9 confirms usage pattern (composite_battle_frame then animate_spell_projectile_paths to show the damage-number rise). target.pos_y multiplier 0x2AC0 = 11200 (row stride), 0x1C8 = 456 (per y-step / sprite row stride), 0x18 = 24 (per-tile x stride) -- all layout strides, not IDs.
